reviews.text: This vet clinic is so nice and cat-friendly! It’s much better and more professional than the dog/cat clinic I used to go to. It really helps to calm the cat down with treats and special sounds. The technician Janet, the vets and the nurses are super nice and professional during the exam, blood draw and everything else. For international travel with cats, I would definitely recommend this place for vaccine and tests. It’s more affordable and knowledgeable than other clinics.🙌🏼

I cannot say enough good things about the team at Chats Montreal including Dr. Nadine Desautels, Mara and Janet. It shows that they truly care about animals; when our cat was sick recently, they checked in by phone many times to ensure the treatment was working well. They also correctly identified the gender of our cat which had been sterilized and misgendered for the first 10 years of its life. Vet services are in general pricey, that’s the sad reality of having a pet but I find their services top notch quality and extremely empathetic and caring. Would recommend to anyone with a cat on the island of Montreal.
A professional and, above all, extremely compassionate team. This clinic cared for our Cocotte for 10 years. Thank you for everything, Dr. Desautels.

Chats Montreal cared for my cat for 10 years until we had to move to vet closer to home. However, the new vet has closed, and my elderly cat became unwell recently and Chats Montreal welcomed us back for an emergency appointment and fantastic care. Everyone, from reception, to the vet tech (Maria?) to Dr Desaultes has been so kind and thorough and took their time to figure out what's going on with Steeners. She's already seeming a lot better from the treatment provided, and I'm so relieved that she's in good hands as we figure out how to make her remaining years happy and healthy.
Good location, good selection of pet food, average costing and unfriendly reception.

The veterinarian and staff at this clinic are, and always have been, very kind and caring. They truly love cats.

The veterinarian and staff at this clinic are, and always have been, very kind and caring. They have a deep love for cats.

A wonderful vet for cats. I've had great appointments, including annual exams and one emergency appointment. They fit me in on the same day and offered great treatment options for an affordable price. The doctor is very kind and gentle with cats. Highly recommend for any cat owner!

I want to thank the two receptionists for their patience with me today during Safran's neutering. I was panicking, and they answered all my calls and kept me updated until I picked up the little one. Thank you so much, and Safran sends you kisses ❤️❤️

Worst vet clinic ever! The vet concern is only making money. They do not even take a step to help you or your pet.
Here is my experience:
I took my cat there because she was not eating well after her neutralization surgery.
They performed blood test and even unnecessary tests like cancer and HIV to charge me more. But they did not even diagnose the issue or prescribed anything for the poor cat. I asked them several times what is the issue and what would be the next step? They answered: “it depends how much you want to spend” or “how much do you want to spend?”
Also, they tried to manipulate me emotionally by mentioning my cat will not survive the night. They told me I have to hospitalize my cat (without any diagnosis) or leave her there while nobody will be there to check on her to inject fluid and the charge they mentioned was huge. I had a panic attack on my way back to home.
I made the right decision and took her to a real vet next day. The poor cat had high kidney infection and the situation was worrisome. But they did their best and taught me to inject fluid under her skin and prescribed medication with even lower charges. My cat is now cured and she is in a good condition.
Thank you for the nice review!
One of the only vets that had the special food I was looking for

They fail to comply with the price accuracy policy: they display one price on the shelf, charge an extra $10 at the register, and then refuse to refund the difference. Even if the supplier has increased their prices, the law requires them to adjust the price display and refund any customer who notices the discrepancy.
Thank you for your 5 star rating and review of Cats Montreal Veterinary Clinic. Thank you for trusting us with the care of your cat!

Amazing vet. My cat recently passed, and the staff sent condolences via mail. This was very touching and kind. I really appreciate everything they've done over 10 years, and I'll definitely be back once I'm ready for another furry friend in my life. ♥️
Overpriced + harasses you to get vaccines
amazing vet! they take so much time to look at the cats and are careful and knowledgeable. 10/10

We brought our cat for vaccinations twice. The experience was ok so we went back for spaying operation.

The spaying and micro chip cost $650 including tax. It was a bit expensive but we wanted the best for our cat.

Our cat came back anxious. She also pooped in the surgery suit that she wore there. We didn’t receive any instructions or help for preventing our cat from licking her incision. Our cat got out of the surgery suit that is too big for her 2 minutes after she got out of the carrier. No E-collar was provided

We had to run to all the pet stores last minute looking for cone and surgery suit- they don’t have them. So before my Amazon order arrived, my cat already licked so much that her incision was infected. She also didn’t sleep for 3 days.

By Monday morning, her incision was already open and smelled really bad. We tried to bring our cat to the this clinic, but they were closed unannounced due to short staffed. We were told to wait at home. They are also very booked the next day with surgeries and the vet is not responding so we wouldn't know if we could actually see her the next day.

We decided to bring our pet to another vet instead. The other vet cleaned her incision and scheduled a couple more follow up for us. But she suggested us to bring our back to the original vet for checkups.

We brought our cat back to this clinic the next day. Once our cat approached this clinic, she started meowing nervously and shaking. Also, the vet is still not sure what she can do we our kitty that day as she is very booked. So we decided to not continue with this clinic.

The whole incident is preventable by proper education for us before the surgery so we can prepare cone and surgery suit beforehand. You would also expect to have someone to reach for complications. When we had the surgery on Thursday, they only told us that they are not open on weekend. The closure on Monday seems to be unplanned. This clinic is unreliable.

We spent an extra $1000 for the complications and our kitty suffered unnecessarily.

TLDR: this clinic is expensive and unreliable. Our cat doesn’t like coming here.
